question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Tropical
solution: The correct answer is '**Cold**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Tropical**' is '**Cold**'. • **Tropical**: very hot and humid. (बहुत गर्म और आर्द्र) • *Example: **tropical** fruit...* • **Cold**: of or at a low or relatively low temperature, especially when compared with the human body. (न्‍यून तापमान वाला; ठंडा, शीत) • *Example: I’m not going into the sea, the water’s too **cold**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Cold.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Lush**: (used for plants or gardens) growing very thickly and well. [(पौधे या बग़ीचे) घने और हरे-भरे] • **Equatorial**: near the imagined line around the center of the earth (the equator). [भूमध्य रेखा के निकट का] • **Sultry**: (used about the weather) hot and uncomfortable. [(मौसम) उमस भरा (गरम और कष्‍टप्रद)] 3d:T971, The correct answer is '**Edible**'.
